description: The public repositories of one GitHub account, with stars and forks. GitHub only — this is the one platform whose repositories we read. `limit` is optional: 30 by default, which is GitHub's own page size, and 100 at most, which is GitHub's ceiling. Requires an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` — free key at https://honesthook.com/docs#key; costs 1 credit.

handle.description: The GitHub username, without the leading @: letters, digits and single hyphens, up to 39 characters.

limit.description: How many repositories to return. Optional, 30 by default, 100 at most. Outside that range the API answers 400.

name: github_repos
title: List a GitHub account's repos
